testsAdded: cf39 in a member project (R/app below R, worktree W, plain member repository P/app with no worktree) the checkout's top's config, W's top's through its link and at the destination, W/app directly, and P's top through its link and at the destination are refused to a subagent and asked of the main session, hook as a process, each read by a loader of a place the builder lists
cf39b the member allow twins: ordinary writes in the project and in W/app, a config-named file in W/notes, one above the checkout - allowed and read by none
cf39c an ordinary write in a member project reads no registration, lists nothing, starts no process and asks no git entry above the project
cf39d NOT MATCHED pinned: a hard link under another name in a member project to W/app's existing config, session standing in W/app, allowed while W/app's loader reads it
cf40 a worktree registered relative (by git where it can, by hand otherwise, never skipped) has its config held at the destination and through the link, a file beside allowed
cf40b a 2 MiB registration pointer cut at the bound asks no tree: trees asked and verdicts equal to those without it
cf40c a worktree under the project whose registration is gone is held as a repository nested under the project
cf40d NOT MATCHED pinned: a separate-git-dir repository's main checkout from a linked worktree project, allowed while its loader reads it
cf36 the generated property gains member and place dimensions; cf36b gains four measured member arrangements; cf36c a representative per family for each project placement
oq5d the journal hook as a process writes one config row for each measured member arrangement written by an edit tool
